create_front_legs: create front legs with scapula, upper arm, lower arm, hand, and finger bodies for a dog MJCF model
build_dog_front_leg_geometry: build the front leg geometry including shoulder joints, elbow joints, wrist joints, and finger joints for the dog model
add_collision_geoms: add collision primitive geoms to scapula, upper arm, ulna, and radius bones using physics binding
configure_joint_axes: configure shoulder and elbow joint axes using primary_axis dictionary and side_sign for left and right sides
create_palm_sensor_sites: create palm sensor sites on the finger bodies and return them as a list for contact sensing
